tables.name: Publication
tables.description: One row per canonical publication across PubMed and DORA. Source provenance and reconciliation method are retained; attribution remains reviewable.

measures.name: Publications
measures.expression:
VAR MatchedKeys = VALUES(PublicationFacility[CanonicalKey])
VAR FacilityFiltered = ISFILTERED(Facility) || ISFILTERED(PublicationFacility)
RETURN COALESCE(IF(FacilityFiltered, CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Publication[CanonicalKey]), KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(MatchedKeys, Publication[CanonicalKey]))), DISTINCTCOUNT(Publication[CanonicalKey])), 0)

measures.name: Publications Last Complete Month
measures.expression:
VAR StartDate = MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthStart])
VAR EndDate = MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthEndExclusive])
RETURN CALCULATE([Publications], REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date],StartDate,EndDate-1), KEEPFILTERS(Publication[PublicationDatePrecision] IN {"day", "month"}))

measures.name: Publications Previous Year Month
measures.expression:
VAR StartDate = EDATE(MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthStart]),-12)
VAR EndDate = EDATE(MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthEndExclusive]),-12)
RETURN CALCULATE([Publications], REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date],StartDate,EndDate-1), KEEPFILTERS(Publication[PublicationDatePrecision] IN {"day", "month"}))

measures.name: Monthly Year-on-Year Change
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Publications Last Complete Month]-[Publications Previous Year Month], [Publications Previous Year Month])

measures.name: Publications Last 24 Complete Months
measures.expression:
VAR StartDate = EDATE(MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthEndExclusive]),-24)
VAR EndDate = MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthEndExclusive])
RETURN CALCULATE([Publications], KEEPFILTERS(DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date],StartDate,EndDate-1)))

measures.name: Reporting Month
measures.expression: IF(ISFILTERED('Date'[YearMonth]), IF(HASONEVALUE('Date'[YearMonth]), SELECTEDVALUE('Date'[YearMonth]), "Select one month"), FORMAT(MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthStart]), "MMMM yyyy"))

measures.name: Register Row Count
measures.expression: VAR N = [Publications] RETURN IF(N > 0, N, BLANK())

measures.name: Selected Month Publications
measures.expression:
VAR HasSelection = ISFILTERED('Date'[YearMonth])
VAR ValidSelection = NOT(HasSelection) || HASONEVALUE('Date'[YearMonth])
VAR StartDate = IF(HasSelection, DATE(YEAR(MIN('Date'[Date])), MONTH(MIN('Date'[Date])), 1), MAX(ReportingWindow[ReportMonthStart]))
VAR EndDate = EDATE(StartDate, 1)
RETURN IF(ValidSelection, CALCULATE([Publications], REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Date'[Date], StartDate, EndDate-1), KEEPFILTERS(Publication[PublicationDatePrecision] IN {"day", "month"})), BLANK())

measures.name: Monthly Register Row Count
measures.expression: VAR N = [Selected Month Publications] RETURN IF(N > 0, N, BLANK())

tables.name: ReleaseMetadata
tables.description: One-row source release identity surface. NativeAcceptance remains false until isolated tenant/report readback proves it.

tables.name: GrantsRegistry
tables.description: Canonical opportunity registry projection. Empty or unaccepted source batches remain empty; deadlines retain raw text and precision.

expressions.name: fnParsePubDate
expression: TextValue = if raw = null then "" else Text.Trim(raw),
YearToken = if List.Count(Parts) > 0 then Parts{0} else "",
YearValue = if Text.Length(YearToken) = 4 then (try Number.FromText(YearToken, "en-US") otherwise null) else null,
ValidYear = if YearValue = null then false else YearValue >= 1500 and YearValue <= 9999 and Number.RoundDown(YearValue) = YearValue,
MonthToken = if List.Count(Parts) > 1 then Text.Lower(Parts{1}) else "",
MonthValue = if Record.HasFields(Months, MonthToken) then Record.Field(Months, MonthToken) else (try Number.FromText(MonthToken, "en-US") otherwise null),
ValidMonth = if MonthValue = null then false else MonthValue >= 1 and MonthValue <= 12 and Number.RoundDown(MonthValue) = MonthValue,
NumericParts = List.AllTrue(List.Transform(Parts, each Text.Length(_) > 0 and Text.Select(_, {"0".."9"}) = _)),
DayValue = if List.Count(Parts) = 3 then (try Number.FromText(Parts{2}, "en-US") otherwise null) else 1,
ValidDay = if DayValue = null then false else DayValue >= 1 and Number.RoundDown(DayValue) = DayValue,
Candidate = if ValidYear and ValidMonth and ValidDay and not IsRange and List.Count(Parts) <= 3 then (try #date(YearValue, MonthValue, DayValue) otherwise null) else null,

Precision = if not ValidYear then "unknown" else if List.Count(Parts) = 1 then "year" else if IsRange then "range" else if Candidate = null then "unknown" else if List.Count(Parts) = 3 then "day" else "month"
[Date = Candidate, Precision = Precision, Year = if ValidYear then YearValue else null, Raw = TextValue]

expressions.name: fnNCBIJson
expression: (endpoint as text, parameters as record, optional attempt as nullable number) as record =>
Start = if attempt = null then 0 else attempt,
Contact = if pNCBIEmail = null then "" else Text.Trim(pNCBIEmail),
WithEmail = if Contact = "" then Common else if not Text.Contains(Contact,"@") then error "pNCBIEmail must be blank or a valid operational contact" else Record.AddField(Common,"email",Contact),

Body = Function.InvokeAfter(() => Web.Contents("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov", [RelativePath="entrez/eutils/" & endpoint, Query=QueryParameters, Timeout=#duration(0,0,2,0), ManualStatusHandling=RetryCodes, IsRetry=n>0]),#duration(0,0,0,if n=0 then 1.1 else Number.Power(2,n))),
each if List.Contains(RetryCodes,[R][Status]) and [N]<4 then [N=[N]+1,R=Fetch([N]+1)] else [N=5,R=null], each [R]),

Parsed = if Final[Status]<>200 then error Error.Record("PubMedHTTP","NCBI request failed after bounded retries; no successful empty result is substituted.",[Status=Final[Status],Endpoint=endpoint]) else Json.Document(Final[Body]),

Result = if not Value.Is(Parsed,type record) then error "Unexpected NCBI JSON response" else if Record.HasFields(Parsed,"error") then error Error.Record("PubMedAPI",Text.From(Parsed[error]),null) else Parsed

expressions.name: fnPubMedXML
expression: // Full PubMed XML metadata; no author-level institutional conclusion is inferred.
Nodes = (v as any) as table => if Value.Is(v,type table) then v else EmptyNodes,
Children = (v as any, name as text) as list => Table.SelectRows(Nodes(v),each [Name]=name)[Value],
Child = (v as any, name as text) as any => List.First(Children(v,name),null),
// Iterative depth-first traversal preserves mixed-content text order.
in if Value.Is(Head,type table) then [Todo=Head[Value]&Tail,Out=null] else [Todo=Tail,Out=if Head=null then null else Text.From(Head)],

DateText = (v as any) as text => let Medline=Child(v,"MedlineDate") in if Medline<>null then TextValue(Medline) else Text.Combine(List.Select(List.Transform({"Year","Month","Day"},each TextValue(Child(v,_))),each _<>"")," "),
Parameters=if Contact="" then Common else Record.AddField(Common,"email",Contact),
Fetch=(n as number) as record => let
XML=if Final[Status]<>200 then error "PubMed EFetch failed after bounded retries" else Xml.Document(Final[Body]),
Checked=if Root=null or List.Count(Books)>0 then error "Unexpected PubMed XML structure; preserve and review unsupported records" else Articles,

Name=if Child(a,"CollectiveName")<>null then TextValue(Child(a,"CollectiveName")) else Text.Combine(List.Select({if Child(a,"ForeName")=null then TextValue(Child(a,"Initials")) else TextValue(Child(a,"ForeName")),TextValue(Child(a,"LastName")),TextValue(Child(a,"Suffix"))},each _<>"")," "),

Reconciled=if List.Count(Returned)<>List.Count(ids) or List.Count(List.Distinct(Returned))<>List.Count(ids) or not List.IsEmpty(List.Difference(ids,Returned)) or not List.IsEmpty(List.Difference(Returned,ids)) then error "EFetch requested and returned PMID sets do not reconcile" else Result

expressions.name: PubMedHarvest
expression: Search = if Record.HasFields(Payload, "esearchresult") then Payload[esearchresult] else error "Missing esearchresult",
// Unknown field names are fatal. An unmatched phrase can be a valid zero-hit affiliation search.

FatalErrors = if Value.Is(SearchErrors,type record) then Record.RemoveFields(SearchErrors,{"phrasesnotfound", "quotedphrasesnotfound", "phrasesignored"},MissingField.Ignore) else error "Unexpected ESearch errorlist structure",
HasFatalErrors = List.AnyTrue(List.Transform(Record.FieldValues(FatalErrors), each if Value.Is(_,type list) then List.Count(_) > 0 else if _ = null then false else Text.From(_) <> "")),
Checked = if Record.HasFields(Search, "ERROR") then error Error.Record("PubMedSearch", Text.From(Search[ERROR]), null)
else if HasFatalErrors then error Error.Record("PubMedSearch", "Search contains errors; check the affiliation query", FatalErrors)

Complete = if Count > 10000 then error Error.Record("PubMedLimit", "Segment this affiliation search into date ranges before retrieving more than 10000 records", [Facility=definition[FacilityName], Count=Count])

else if Count < 0 or Count <> List.Count(List.Distinct(IDs)) or List.Count(IDs) <> List.Count(List.Distinct(IDs)) then error Error.Record("PubMedIncomplete", "ESearch count does not match retrieved distinct PMIDs", [Facility=definition[FacilityName], Count=Count, Retrieved=List.Count(IDs)])
if Record.HasFields(Checked, "warninglist") then Checked[warninglist] else null,
if Record.HasFields(SearchErrors,"phrasesnotfound") and List.Count(SearchErrors[phrasesnotfound]) > 0 then [phrasesnotfound=SearchErrors[phrasesnotfound]] else null,
if Record.HasFields(SearchErrors,"phrasesignored") and List.Count(SearchErrors[phrasesignored]) > 0 then [phrasesignored=SearchErrors[phrasesignored]] else null
Warnings = if List.Count(WarningParts) > 0 then Text.FromBinary(Json.FromValue(WarningParts), TextEncoding.Utf8) else "",
// Accumulate and buffer each request result to avoid unconstrained parallel fan-out.
in if Force >= 0 then state & {Result} else error "Invalid count")),
// Preserve the earlier collector's scope-review search without asserting a facility link.
ScopeSearch = SearchOne([FacilityKey="scope-review:cphu",FacilityName="Cairns Public Health Unit - scope review",PubMedQuery="""Cairns Public Health Unit""[Affiliation]"]),
Result = if Record.HasFields(Payload, "result") then Payload[result] else error "Missing ESummary result",

CheckedIDs = if List.Count(List.Difference(ids,ReturnedIDs)) > 0 or List.Count(List.Difference(ReturnedIDs,ids)) > 0 or List.Count(ReturnedIDs) <> List.Count(ids) then error "ESummary PMID reconciliation failed" else ReturnedIDs,
else if Text.From(Row[uid]) <> id then error "ESummary UID mismatch" else Row)
Trial = Text.Contains(TypeText,"clinical trial") or Text.Contains(TypeText,"randomized controlled trial") or Text.Contains(TypeText,"controlled clinical trial"),

Class = if Trial then "Clinical trial" else if Text.Contains(TypeText,"meta-analysis") then "Meta-analysis" else if Text.Contains(TypeText,"systematic review") then "Systematic review" else if Text.Contains(TypeText,"review") then "Review" else if Text.Contains(TypeText,"journal article") then "Journal article" else "Other",
DOI = if List.Count(DOIValues) = 0 then null else Text.From(DOIValues{0}[value]),
ModelDate = if ParsedDate[Date] = null then null else if Date.Year(ParsedDate[Date]) < 1900 then null else ParsedDate[Date],
ModelOnlineDate = if OnlineParsed[Date] = null then null else if Date.Year(OnlineParsed[Date]) < 1900 then null else OnlineParsed[Date],
ModelDatePrecision = if ParsedDate[Date] <> null and ModelDate = null then "outside-model-range" else ParsedDate[Precision],
PublicationMonth = if List.Contains({"day","month"},ModelDatePrecision) then Date.ToText(ModelDate, "yyyy-MM", "en-AU") else null,

Notice = if Text.Contains(TypeText,"retracted publication") then "Retracted publication" else if Text.Contains(TypeText,"retraction of publication") then "Retraction notice" else if Text.Contains(TypeText,"expression of concern") then "Expression of concern" else "No notice in retrieved publication types"
AttributionStatus=if List.IsEmpty(FacilityKeys) then "Historical scope query match - institutional scope needs review" else "Affiliation search match - not manually verified",

AttributionEvidence="Retrieved by PubMed affiliation search; not author-level verification. Queries: " & Text.Combine(List.Sort(List.Distinct(MatchedQueries & (if List.Contains(ScopeSearch[IDs],PMID) then {"""Cairns Public Health Unit""[Affiliation] - historical institutional scope requires review"} else {}))), " | "),

VerifiedPublications = if Table.RowCount(Publications) <> List.Count(AllIDs) or List.Count(List.Distinct(Publications[PMID])) <> List.Count(AllIDs) then error "Final publication row count mismatch" else Publications,

AuditRows = List.Transform(SearchResults & {ScopeSearch}, (s) => [FacilityKey=s[FacilityKey], SearchCount=s[SearchCount], QueryTranslation=s[QueryTranslation], Warnings=s[Warnings], QueryVersion="2026-09-11-v2", RefreshedAtUTC=RefreshedUTC]),

expressions.name: PubMedFullMetadata
expression: Tables=List.Accumulate(Batches,{},(state,batch)=>let T=Table.Buffer(fnPubMedXML(batch)),N=Table.RowCount(T) in if N=List.Count(batch) then state&{T} else error "PubMed full metadata batch is incomplete"),
Verified=if Table.RowCount(Result)<>List.Count(IDs) or List.Count(List.Distinct(Result[PMID]))<>List.Count(IDs) then error "PubMed full metadata key reconciliation failed" else Result

expressions.name: PubMedPublications
expression: Verified=if List.AnyTrue(List.Transform(Joined[Full],each Table.RowCount(_)<>1)) then error "PubMed summary/full metadata join is not one-to-one" else Joined,
F=r[Full]{0},Parsed=fnParsePubDate(F[IssueDateRaw]),D=if Parsed[Date]=null then null else if Date.Year(Parsed[Date])<1900 then null else Parsed[Date],
Precision=if Parsed[Date]<>null and D=null then "outside-model-range" else Parsed[Precision],
PublicationMonth=if D<>null and List.Contains({"day","month"},Precision) then Date.ToText(D,"yyyy-MM","en-AU") else null,
AttributionEvidence=r[AttributionEvidence]&" Full author-level source statements retained separately in PubMedAuthorEvidence; no automatic institutional approval."]

Typed=Table.TransformColumnTypes(Result,{{"PMID",type text},{"Title",type text},{"Journal",type text},{"Authors",type text},{"DOI",type text},{"PubMedURL",type text},{"PublicationDate",type date},{"PublicationDateRaw",type text},{"PublicationDatePrecision",type text},{"PublicationMonth",type text},{"PublicationYear",Int64.Type},{"OnlineDate",type date},{"OnlineDateRaw",type text},{"AuthorCount",Int64.Type},{"PublicationTypes",type text},{"PublicationClass",type text},{"IsClinicalTrial",type logical},{"IsEvidenceSynthesis",type logical},{"MatchedFacilities",type text},{"AttributionStatus",type text},{"AttributionEvidence",type text},{"PublicationNotice",type text},{"FacilityMatchCount",Int64.Type},{"RefreshedAtUTC",type datetime},{"Abstract",type text}})

expressions.name: PubMedAuthorEvidence
expression: in List.Combine(List.Transform(List.Positions(Authors),(i)=>let A=Authors{i},Affiliations=if List.IsEmpty(A[Affiliations]) then {null} else A[Affiliations]

in List.Transform(List.Positions(Affiliations),(j)=>[PMID=r[PMID],AuthorIndex=i+1,AuthorName=A[Name],AffiliationIndex=j+1,AffiliationText=Affiliations{j},EvidenceKind="PubMed XML author affiliation; institutional scope not automatically approved"]))))),

expressions.name: PubMedMetadataChunks
expression: // UTF-8 hex chunks avoid text normalization and per-cell truncation in the model.

expressions.name: DoraSourceObservations
expression: // Raw source staging only; not canonical publications or historical completeness.
Channel = if Table.RowCount(Source) = 1 and Table.HasColumns(Source,"channel") then Source{0}[channel] else error "DORA RSS channel schema changed",

Items = if Table.RowCount(Channel) <> 1 then error "DORA RSS channel count changed" else if Table.HasColumns(Channel,"item") then Channel{0}[item] else #table(type table [title=nullable text,link=nullable text,description=nullable text,pubDate=nullable text],{}),
Checked = if Table.HasColumns(Items,{"title","link"}) then Items else error "DORA RSS item schema changed",

expressions.name: DoraHistoricalMetadata
expression: // Public collection snapshot, not a durable first-observed registry.
Fetch=(path as text, query as record) as binary =>
Get=(n as number) as record => let
in if Final[Status]<>200 then error "DORA HTTP retrieval failed; incomplete history must not replace prior data" else Final[Body],
Page=(offset as number) as record => let
Count=if List.Count(Counts)<>1 then error "DORA collection count is unavailable or ambiguous" else Counts{0},
Links=Html.Table(Body,{{"Path","table[summary='This table browses all dspace content'] a[title='Visit this item']",each [Attributes][href]}})[Path],
Checked=if List.AnyTrue(List.Transform(Links,each not Text.StartsWith(_,"/qldresearchjspui/handle/1/"))) then error "Unexpected DORA item URL" else Links

Pages=List.Buffer(List.Accumulate(Offsets,{First},(state,n)=>let P=Page(n*20), Forced=List.Count(P[Paths]) in if P[Count]<>Expected then error "DORA collection changed during traversal" else if Forced>=0 then state&{P} else error "Invalid page")),
Keys=if List.Count(Paths)<>Expected or List.Count(List.Distinct(Paths))<>Expected then error "DORA collection keys do not reconcile" else List.Buffer(Paths),
RecordFor=(path as text) as record => let
One=(key as text) as nullable text=>let V=Values(key) in if List.Count(V)>1 then error "Conflicting DORA single-value metadata" else List.First(V,null),
Identity=if Title=null or not List.Contains({URL,Text.Replace(URL,"https://","http://")},URI) then error "DORA canonical identity/title mismatch" else URL,
Markers={"Cairns & Hinterland Hospital and Health Service (CHHHS) affiliated authors:","Cairns & Hinterland Hospital and Health Service (CHHHS) affiliated author:"},
AttributionEvidence=if Evidence="" then "No explicit DORA affiliation evidence; review required." else Evidence,
Records=List.Accumulate(Keys,{},(state,path)=>let R=RecordFor(path),Force=Text.Length(R[FullMetadataJSON]) in if Force>0 then state&{R} else error "Empty DORA metadata"),
Verified=if Table.RowCount(Result)<>Expected or List.Count(List.Distinct(Result[DORAKey]))<>Expected then error "DORA metadata keys do not reconcile" else Result

expressions.name: DoraHarvest
expression: // Retain raw observations separately; this reference is not durable storage.
NormalizeTitle = (value as nullable text) as text => if value = null then "" else Text.Select(Text.Lower(value), {"a".."z","0".."9"}),
ExtractBetween = (value as nullable text, start as text, finish as text) as nullable text =>
if value = null or not Text.Contains(value,start) then null else try Text.Trim(Text.BeforeDelimiter(Text.AfterDelimiter(value,start),finish)) otherwise null,
ExtractAffiliatedAuthors = (value as nullable text) as nullable text =>
singular = "Cairns & Hinterland Hospital and Health Service (CHHHS) affiliated author: ",
plural = "Cairns & Hinterland Hospital and Health Service (CHHHS) affiliated authors: ",
marker = if value <> null and Text.Contains(value,plural) then plural else if value <> null and Text.Contains(value,singular) then singular else null,
result = if marker = null then null else Text.Trim(Text.AfterDelimiter(value,marker))
// RSS pubDate is a feed timestamp, not corroborated publication-date evidence.

AddEvidence = Table.AddColumn(AddCHHHSAuthors,"AttributionEvidence",each if [CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors]=null or Text.Trim([CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors])="" then "No CHHHS affiliation statement found in RSS description; review required." else "DORA RSS CHHHS affiliated author statement: " & [CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors],type text),
AddYear = Table.AddColumn(AddDate,"PublicationYear",each if [PublicationDate]=null then null else Date.Year([PublicationDate]),Int64.Type),
Checked = if Table.HasColumns(Renamed,{"DORAKey","Title","PublicationYear","DORAURL"}) then Renamed else error "DORA RSS schema changed"

expressions.name: CanonicalPublications
expression: // Stable output schema also applies when either source has no records.
NormalizeTitle = (value as nullable text) as text => if value = null then "" else Text.Select(Text.Lower(value), {"a".."z","0".."9"}),
NormalizePMID = (value as nullable text) as nullable text =>
let t = if value = null then "" else Text.Trim(value)
in if t <> "" and Text.Select(t,{"0".."9"}) = t and not Text.StartsWith(t,"0") then t else null,
NormalizeDOI = (value as nullable text) as nullable text =>
raw = if value = null then "" else Text.Lower(Text.Trim(value)),
t = if prefix = null then raw else Text.Trim(Text.Range(raw,Text.Length(prefix))),

valid = Text.StartsWith(t,"10.") and Text.Length(registration)>=4 and Text.Length(registration)<=9 and Text.Select(registration,{"0".."9"})=registration and suffix<>"" and Text.Remove(t,{" ","#(tab)","#(cr)","#(lf)"})=t
in if valid then t else null,
in (p <> null and p <> "" and NormalizePMID(p) = null) or (d <> null and d <> "" and NormalizeDOI(d) = null),
exact = Table.SelectRows(PubMedNorm,(p as record) => (doi <> null and NormalizeDOI(p[DOI]) = doi) or (suppliedPMID <> null and NormalizePMID(p[PMID]) = suppliedPMID)),

conflict = List.AnyTrue(List.Transform(Table.ToRecords(exact),(p as record) => (doi <> null and NormalizeDOI(p[DOI]) <> null and NormalizeDOI(p[DOI]) <> doi) or (suppliedPMID <> null and NormalizePMID(p[PMID]) <> null and NormalizePMID(p[PMID]) <> suppliedPMID))),
candidates = Table.SelectRows(PubMedNorm,(p as record) => title <> "" and d[PublicationYear] <> null and p[PublicationYear] = d[PublicationYear] and p[NormalizedTitle] = title),
matched = n = 1 and not conflict and not invalid,
pmid = if matched then exact{0}[PMID] else null,

method = if invalid then "invalid-identifiers-needs-review" else if conflict then "conflicting-identifiers-needs-review" else if n > 1 then "ambiguous-identifiers-needs-review" else if matched then (if suppliedPMID = NormalizePMID(exact{0}[PMID]) then "PMID" else "DOI") else if titleCount > 1 then "ambiguous-title+year" else if titleCount = 1 then "possible-title+year-needs-review" else "DORA-only"

in [PMID=pmid,Method=method,CandidateCount=if n > 0 then n else titleCount,CandidateKeys=Text.Combine(List.Transform(if n > 0 then exact[PMID] else candidates[PMID],each "PMID:" & _),"; ")],type record),
urls = if has then Text.Combine(List.Distinct(List.RemoveNulls(d[DORAURL])),"; ") else null,
chhhs = if has then Text.Combine(List.Distinct(List.RemoveNulls(d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors])),"; ") else null,
abstract = if List.Count(abstracts)>0 then abstracts{0} else null

MatchedFacilities=p[MatchedFacilities],CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors=chhhs,Abstract=abstract,SourceSet=if has then "PubMed; DORA" else "PubMed",DedupMethod=if has then Text.Combine(List.Distinct(d[DedupMethod]),"; ") else "PMID",

AttributionStatus=if has then p[AttributionStatus] & "; DORA identifier match" else p[AttributionStatus],PublicationNotice=p[PublicationNotice],FacilityMatchCount=p[FacilityMatchCount],RefreshedAtUTC=p[RefreshedAtUTC]
OnlineDate=null,OnlineDateRaw="",AuthorCount=if d[Authors]=null or d[Authors]="" then null else List.Count(Text.Split(d[Authors],";")),

MatchedFacilities=if d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors] <> null and Text.Trim(d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors]) <> "" then "Cairns and Hinterland HHS" else "",CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors=d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors],Abstract=d[Abstract],SourceSet="DORA",DedupMethod=d[DedupMethod],

AttributionStatus=(if d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors] <> null and Text.Trim(d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors]) <> "" then "DORA author affiliation statement" else "DORA attribution needs review") & (if d[DedupMethod] <> "DORA-only" then "; identity needs review" else ""),PublicationNotice="DORA full metadata; observed public collection snapshot; institutional scope remains reviewable",FacilityMatchCount=if d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors] <> null and Text.Trim(d[CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors]) <> "" then 1 else 0,RefreshedAtUTC=DateTimeZone.RemoveZone(DateTimeZone.FixedUtcNow())
Verified = if Table.RowCount(Combined) <> List.Count(List.Distinct(Combined[CanonicalKey])) then error "Canonical publication key is not unique" else Combined,

DoraBridge = Table.FromRecords(List.Transform(Table.ToRecords(Table.SelectRows(DoraOnly,each [CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors] <> null and Text.Trim([CHHHSAffiliatedAuthors]) <> "")), each [CanonicalKey=[DORAKey],FacilityKey="hhs"]),type table [CanonicalKey=text,FacilityKey=text]),
